study type: Prediction model development and validation study
outcome: Postpartum readmission for hypertension or pre-eclampsia
cohort: 28,201 postpartum individuals from two tertiary care health systems in the Southern and Northeastern USA
finding: A prediction model including six variables (age, parity, maximum postpartum diastolic blood pressure, birthweight, pre-eclampsia before discharge, and delivery mode) showed adequate discrimination for predicting postpartum readmission for hypertension and pre-eclampsia.
mod_finding: Delivery mode was included in the final prediction model, and an interaction between pre-eclampsia and delivery mode was observed.
